When calling this API over HTTP, this parameter is required and must be appended to the request URL. For information about how to obtain the token, see Enterprise access token (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.5e2a281frQyDQ8&docId=3769985).
